worldcombat.skill.smokescreen.summary: Spits an obscuring cloud at a spot; foes standing in it lose accuracy and strike weaker, and carry an aftertaste when they leave. The cloud stays put, so it can blind an enemy or hide you.
worldcombat.skill.smokescreen.use.0: Shroud a foe in a cloud it cannot aim through
worldcombat.skill.smokescreen.use.1: Lay it in front of you to break sight lines and catch a breath
worldcombat.skill.smokescreen.descriptio: Foes standing in the cloud strike weaker (attack damage reduced by 20%%) and lose %1$s accuracy stage(s); the accuracy drop stays until cleared or the fight ends, while the attack penalty follows the choking itself and lingers about %2$s after they leave.
The cloud covers about a %1$s block radius and lasts %2$s; it only chokes foes, stays where it lands, and keeps catching enemies standing inside or entering later.

The puff is sent within %1$s blocks and travels at %2$s; gathering it takes %3$s with a %4$s cooldown. The cloud never moves, so a misplaced cloud wastes the cooldown, and it dissipates if the caster strays more than 48 blocks away or falls.
worldcombat.skill.smokescreen.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.smokescreen.preference: Thick: radius x0.8 but cloud duration x1.35 and denser smoke, at +4 ticks wind-up and x1.2 cooldown; Thin: radius x1.3 with a faster, cheaper cast, but a shorter and lighter cloud.
The companion only considers smoke while a threat is within this many blocks; smaller lays clouds up close, larger smokes foes out from afar.
It holds the smoke until this many visible enemies stand near the landing point; set 1 to smoke any sighting.
When on, the companion may leave its post to smoke under a Hold order.
